aiResearchSummary.text: MindPortal is researching systems and methods involving neural interfaces and brain computer interfaces that use wearable devices and optical based brain signal acquisition to collect and process non invasive brain activity. The work includes decoding imagined speech and imagined sentences from high density brain recordings, enabling direct brain to AI communication, determining user intentions and supporting extended reality and eye tracking. Together these efforts focus on neural decoding, wearable BCIs, user intent inference and AR or VR interaction.
